jobs.title: Associate AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.shortDescription: Build real-world AI applications, workflow automations, and full-stack products with LLMs, RAG, and modern web technologies. Ideal for 0–1 years experience with prior internship exposure.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Associate AI & Automation Engineer who is excited about building real-world AI applications, workflow automations, and web-based products. You will work closely with the engineering team to develop AI-powered features, automate business processes, integrate LLMs, and contribute to full-stack product development.

This role is ideal for candidates with prior internship experience who enjoy experimenting with AI technologies while also being comfortable building and integrating web applications.
jobs.applicationPrompt: Your resume, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, portfolio or projects (if available), and a brief description of your most interesting AI or web development project.
requirements: 0–1 years of experience with at least one internship in AI, Software Development, Automation, Full Stack Development, or a related field
Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Generative AI concepts
Experience integrating APIs and automation workflows
Familiarity with Large Language Models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.)
Understanding of Prompt Engineering concepts
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar
Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) fundamentals
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with ability to learn new technologies quickly
Good communication, collaboration skills, and a self-driven mindset
Nice to have: Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma)
Nice to have: Experience with FastAPI, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, or GitHub Actions
Nice to have: Experience building AI agents, multi-agent systems, or contributions to open-source projects
Bonus: Prior work on AI Agents, Workflow Automation Systems, Full-Stack Web Applications, or Internal Productivity Tools
responsibilities: Build and maintain AI-powered applications using modern LLMs and AI frameworks
Develop workflow automations using APIs, AI agents, and no-code/low-code automation platforms
Create AI-driven features such as chatbots, document processing systems, search systems, and intelligent assistants
Work with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and vector databases
Integrate third-party APIs and AI services into web applications
Develop and maintain frontend and backend components of web applications
Assist in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI experimentation
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to prototype and ship new features quickly
Research emerging AI tools, frameworks, and automation technologies
benefits: Full-time role with competitive compensation based on skills and experience
Remote / Hybrid work flexibility
Hands-on work on AI agents, automation systems, and full-stack products
Exposure to modern LLMs, RAG, and agent frameworks
Collaboration with product and engineering teams on fast-paced feature delivery
Opportunity to grow into advanced AI and platform engineering responsibilities
selectionProcess: Application review (resume, GitHub, LinkedIn, and portfolio)
Technical assignment focused on AI, automation, or full-stack skills
